description.title: תנאי פוליסת מכלול - Underinsurance
description.summary: This table details how 'Mecholal' insurance benefits are adjusted in cases of underinsurance. It explains the ratio used to calculate partial payments when the insured sum is less than the required sum.
description.embed_passage: פוליסת מכלול מתייחסת למצב של חסר ביטוח, בו סכום הביטוח שצוין נמוך מהסכום הנדרש. במקרה כזה, תשלום הביטוח יחושב ביחס בין סכום הביטוח שצוין לסכום שהיה צריך להיות מבוטח, כפי שמופיע בסעיף 5.1. לדוגמה, אם סכום הביטוח שצוין הוא 100,000 ₪ והסכום הנדרש הוא 150,000 ₪, תשלום הביטוח יקטן בהתאם.
description.column_axis: Clauses related to underinsurance calculation and exceptions
notable_values: Paragraph 5.1: Basis for determining the sum insured
Paragraph 4.1: Cover for data and software restoration
Paragraph 4.2: Cover for additional operating expenses
First loss basis: Applies to data/software and operating expenses

sketch:
5.3 Underinsurance
If, at the time of the occurrence of the insured event, the sum insured specified in the schedule for Chapter Four is lower than the sum insured required in accordance with paragraph 5.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured), the insurer's liability will be reduced and the insurance benefits will be paid only partially, according to the ratio between the sum insured specified in the schedule for Chapter Four and the sum which should have been insured in accordance with whatsoever appearing in paragraph 5.1 above (basis for determining the sum insured).
Whatsoever appearing in this condition shall not apply with the additional covers listed in paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2 above (cover for data and software restoration as well as cover for additional operating expenses, respectively), in respect of which whatsoever appearing in paragraphs 4.1.5.1 and 4.2.6.1 respectively shall apply (on a first loss basis).
